title: Vale Fundão agreement municipal-adherence update
publisher: Vale S.A. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Nineteen additional eligible municipalities joined, bringing formal adherence to 45 of 49 eligible municipalities.
summary: Vale reported that 19 additional municipalities joined the definitive Fundão compensation and reparation agreement, bringing adherence to 45 of 49; joining municipalities must waive related litigation and receive catch-up installments before following the existing payment schedule.
